name: notion-meetings
title: Notion Meetings
description: Open the next page of each recurring meeting in Notion, add agenda items without opening it, and create the page from its template when nobody has made it yet.
author: jesse_gilbert

commands.name: meetings
commands.title: Meetings
commands.subtitle: Notion
commands.description: Your recurring meetings and 1:1s, each at its next Notion page

preferences.name: notionToken
preferences.title: Notion token
preferences.description: Notion integration token. Leave empty to read NOTION_API_KEY from the env file below.

preferences.name: notionEnvFile
preferences.title: Notion env file
preferences.description: Dotenv file holding NOTION_API_KEY, used when the token field is empty.

preferences.name: googleSecretsDir
preferences.title: Google login folder
preferences.description: Folder with oauth_client.json and token.json from a Google OAuth login (needs the calendar.readonly scope), e.g. the Kairos repo's lab/lib/.secrets/google. Leave empty to skip the calendar and use each meeting's usual weekday.

preferences.name: initials
preferences.title: Your initials
preferences.description: Prefixed to items you add under an Agenda heading, for meetings configured with useInitials.
